modify.note: In `reportWrongAssignment` (reportWrongAssignment.handler.ts): check booking access, load the booking's team and routing-form response, reject an existing report, and then create the new record through WrongAssignmentReportRepository. Return its ID with the handler's existing response. Keep the database uniqueness constraint as the final protection against concurrent submissions, translating the relevant P2002 conflict into the same localized duplicate-report error as the earlier existence check. Preserve the existing reporting notification flow without sending it twice for a rejected duplicate. Persist `routedFromRoutingFormReponse.formId` when present. Add the access-checked `hasWrongAssignmentReport` query for the dialog. Keep authorization and duplicate protection on the server. WrongAssignmentDialog: use the `hasWrongAssignmentReport` query to display the already-reported warning and disable submission, while keeping authorization and duplicate protection on the server. Fix clearing the assignee Select so an empty selection clears the form value instead of leaving the previous assignee behind.
BookingRepository: include `routedFromRoutingFormReponse.formId` in the booking repository result (findByUidIncludeEventTypeAndTeamAndAssignmentReason), so the handler can persist it when present.
